content.short: Compares Flashbots MEV-Boost Relays with competitors.
content.description: Launched after the Ethereum Merge in September 2022 by anonymous developers, the Flashbots MEV Dashboard aims to publicize metrics on Flashbots products and the wider MEV ecosystem. It provides a centralized view of activity, enabling MEV researchers, traders, and enthusiasts to monitor the flow of rewards and the number of proposals delegated to MEV-Boost Relays, and to compare these figures directly with those of competing relays. By consolidating these metrics in one place, the dashboard supports transparent analysis of relay performance, incentives, and evolving MEV dynamics across networks.
content.meta: Flashbots MEV Dashboard tracks metrics for Flashbots products and MEV ecosystem. Discover Flashbots MEV Dashboard and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
